The '''2026 Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council election''' is scheduled to be held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] on the same day.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Key dates for voters in 2026 {{!}} Electoral Commission |url=https://www.electoralcommission.org.uk/voting-and-elections/key-dates-voters-2026 |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=www.electoralcommission.org.uk |language=en}}</ref>

== Background ==
In [[2024 Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council election|2024]], Labour retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Gateshead result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E08000037 |access-date=2026-01-27 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Changes 2024–2026:
*June 2024: Bob Goldsworthy (Labour) dies – by-election held September 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Dawson |first1=Kristy |title=Tributes following the death of 'dedicated and hard-working' councillor |url=https://www.chroniclelive.co.uk/news/north-east-news/tributes-following-death-long-serving-29414615 |access-date=28 January 2026 |work=Chronicle Live |date=24 June 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
*September 2024: 
**Robert Waugh (Labour) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Bridges Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/1045/#2024-09-12 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref>
**Sonya Hawkins (Liberal Democrats) resigns – by-election held October 2024<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Tories put on a West End show |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2024/09/tories-put-on-a-west-end-show/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref>
**Jane McCoid (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Shakespeare |first1=Austen |title=Gateshead councillor resigns from Labour Party with attack on Government |url=https://www.chroniclelive.co.uk/news/north-east-news/gateshead-council-councillor-resigned-labour-29990709 |access-date=28 January 2026 |work=Chronicle Live |date=23 September 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
*October 2024: Susan Craig (Liberal Democrats) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Whickham North Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/1061/#2024-10-24 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref>
*June 2025: Robert Waugh (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Social justice gets reformed |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2025/06/social-justice-gets-reformed/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk}}</ref>
*January 2026: Tom Graham (Labour) dies – seat left vacant until 2026 election<ref>{{cite news |last1=Shakespeare |first1=Austen |title=Tributes paid to 'reliable, thoughtful and hard‑working' Gateshead councillor |url=https://www.chroniclelive.co.uk/news/north-east-news/councillor-gateshead-tributes-paid-heartbroken-33248194 |access-date=28 January 2026 |work=Chronicle Live |date=16 January 2026 |language=en}}</ref>
*March 2026: Jim Turnbull (Labour) dies – seat left vacant until 2026 election<ref>{{cite news |last1=Shakespeare |first1=Austen |title=Tributes paid to 'dedicated' councillor with more than 40 years public service |url=https://www.chroniclelive.co.uk/news/north-east-news/tributes-paid-long-serving-north-33599883 |access-date=7 May 2026 |work=Chronicle Live |date=16 March 2026 |language=en}}</ref>
